description: Alibaba's Wan 3.0: cinematic 5-second videos from text or a starting image, at 480p, 720p or 1080p. Compared with other video tools: mid-priced. Price: from $0.048 per second (one call: from $0.238 per 5-second video), charged only on success. Price depends on resolution: 480p $0.238, 720p $0.474, 1080p $0.946 (default 720p). One call = one 5-second video.

image.description: Optional starting image (https URL). Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)
